title: Diaphragmatic Movement Before and After Stellate Ganglion Block : A Ultrasonographic Study
brief_summary: The temporary diaphrgmatic dysfunction will occur after stellate ganglion block(SGB) and will be easily detected by M-mode ultrasonography
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ASA class I-II patients who have head and neck pain or shoulder pain or sudden sensory neural hearing loss

Exclusion Criteria:

* coagulopathy, pulmonary disease, neuropathy
